{{samename|volumes published in English by VIZ Media|List of Pokémon XY volumes}}
Due to chapters taking at least two years before being collected into a volume, the {{MangaArc|X & Y}} of Pokémon Adventures was separately collected into mini-volumes by [[Shogakukan]] in Japan, which began in April 2014 and ended in December 2016. The chapters included in these mini-volumes were only ones that were published in the magazine ''CoroCoro Ichiban''. Once the {{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}} ended in the regular volumes, the X & Y arc started to be properly collected in that format as well.

These volumes have also been localized in English by [[Shogakukan Asia]], in {{pmin|France|European French}} by Kurokawa, in {{pmin|Germany|German}} by [[Panini Comics]] and in {{pmin|Spain|European Spanish}} by [[Norma Editorial]].
